_comment: Meyers Building Group, Bowral NSW. Hand-written 2026-09-24 from https://meyersbuildinggroup.com.au because `npm run new` is broken in this container (see HANDOVER.md). Every page of their GoDaddy site was read with curl. Their site names no person and no town, so the owner's name (Darren Meyers) comes from the ABR trading names on their ABN, and Bowral from the ABR postcode and their Yellow Pages listing. No Google rating or reviews exist (data/google_reviews_top25.json), and there are no testimonials on their site, so reviews is empty and the proof is their own sourced facts: 80% returning clients and referrals, over 30 years, fully licensed and insured, and their registered ABN. The builders preset's process, FAQ and responsePromise describe a generic builder and would be invented claims here, so all three are overridden with lines from their own site. Finish round (2026-09-24): their 7 photos (one job, 960px wide) are used only at native size in the gallery and on two service cards; the hero, statement, aperture and the new homes card are labelled samples. Nothing is upscaled. No stats strip: the only number available is 'over 30 years', which the owner section already shows as 30+, and a lone stat left a large empty band on desktop. No serviceAreas: their site lists no suburbs, and inventing Highlands towns would be unsourced. See BRIEF.md.

photos._comment: 10 photos. 6 used here are Meyers Building Group's own (their Project Gallery, img1.wsimg.com/isteam/ip/7811a3ed-98ba-483b-8a43-fd6e5038d34b/), all showing one property, used at their native 960px (855px for the garage) or smaller, never upscaled and not retouched: 4 in the gallery, 2 on service cards; the garage photo is left out so the gallery grid stays even. 4 are labelled samples (hero, statement, aperture, and the new homes card); their alt text and captions describe them generically and never as Meyers' work. No caption names a suburb.

faq.q: Can you keep the heritage features?
faq.a: Yes. In a kitchen we can modernise, or keep the heritage elements. We also restore rundown and unfinished projects and make them new again.

faq.q: Can you add a granny flat?
faq.a: Yes. An extension can add rooms, a bathroom, a kitchen or more living space, and we can add a granny flat to your home.

faq.q: Can you prepare the site as well?
faq.a: Yes. When a job needs some preparation, our own earth moving service moves the earth and rubble first, and then we build.
Yes. We build or renovate the space your business runs from: offices, warehouses and retail spaces.

faq.q: Can we meet outside business hours?
faq.a: We work flexible hours to meet with you about what you need, and we're happy to come out to the site to talk it through.
